description: Modules that turn a command STRING into a process without core.security.execution_authority. Each entry names the property that makes it tolerable today. tests/test_general_execution_surfaces_are_governed.py fails on any module not listed here and fails when a listed module no longer matches, so this list may only SHRINK.

grandfathered.core/runtime/subprocess_gateway.py: the sink itself; it is what every governed surface spawns through
grandfathered.core/actuators/process_supervisor.py: binary allowlist plus verify_actuator_authority on the actuate path
grandfathered.core/adaptation/safe_optimizer.py: the command is operator configuration for the LoRA trainer, not caller text
grandfathered.core/capability_engine.py: read-only binary allowlist: cat, echo, find, grep, ls, pwd, tree
